unit.title: The Sikh Diaspora's Institutions and Impact

contentBlocks.text: Yesterday you learned where the diaspora lives. Today: how diaspora Gurdwaras grew into much more than places of worship!

Beyond worship, diaspora Gurdwaras often expanded into genuine community civic centers, hosting Punjabi language classes, cultural events, community support services, and gathering spaces for a diaspora community's shared life — a real expansion of the Gurdwara's role from last week's 'community anchor' introduction. Explain why a diaspora community, newly settled in an unfamiliar country, might especially need the Gurdwara to serve these additional civic functions, beyond worship alone.
You just learned how the Gurdwara's role expanded in the diaspora! Tomorrow we'll look at the diaspora's real humanitarian contributions.

objectives: Understand the diaspora Gurdwara's expanded civic functions beyond worship
Explain why a newly settled community especially benefits from these expanded functions
materialsNeeded: Yesterday's worksheet, last week's Gurdwara-anchor content
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's diaspora-regions work and last week's Gurdwara-anchor content briefly.
2. Introduce the Gurdwara's expanded civic functions.
3. Have the child explain why a newly settled community especially benefits.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's humanitarian-contributions lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: list the specific functions (language classes, cultural events, community support) one at a time and ask which one seems most important for someone newly arrived
Ready for more: ask the child to compare the diaspora Gurdwara's expanded role to how a community center or cultural association might function for other newly settled communities
This is a genuine extension of last week's Gurdwara-as-anchor content, showing specifically HOW that anchoring role works in practice
teacherGuide.answerKey: A newly settled community, especially in an unfamiliar country, benefits enormously from having one trusted, familiar place that offers language, culture, and community support alongside worship — the Gurdwara becomes a genuine anchor precisely because it meets multiple real needs at once, helping people build a new life while staying connected to their heritage.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's global-diaspora thread, extending last week's Gurdwara-as-anchor content into its specific civic functions.
